note: IronChests sync-NBT bridge for the converted 1.21.1 jar. The 1.20.1 one-argument readNbt/writeNbt calls survive inside GenericChestBlockEntity and, because both have the same descriptor, the conversion also swapped which one each sync method calls.

methodRedirects.evidence: First chest open (runs/p66-ironchests-gui/latest-model-shim.log): NoSuchMethodError 'void GenericChestBlockEntity.method_11007(class_2487)' at GenericChestBlockEntity.getSyncTag(GenericChestBlockEntity.java:192), reached from SyncableData.sync -> openersCounter -> method_5435 -> GenericChestMenu.<init> -> method_5465 -> ServerPlayer.openHandledScreen -> GenericChestBlock.method_9534. getSyncTag must serialise the entity, which is the 1.21.1 two-argument writeNbt (method_11014); the converted call names the one-argument readNbt instead.

Same converted class: loadSyncTag(NbtCompound) calls the one-argument method_11014, which no longer exists in 1.21.1 (BlockEntity.writeNbt now takes a HolderLookup.Provider). loadSyncTag applies a received tag to the entity, i.e. the two-argument readNbt (method_11007); the conversion swapped it with getSyncTag's call.
